About the Author
Pedro F. Barros
Written & signed as Pedro P. da Fonseca

Pedro F. Barros is a Portuguese writer, philosopher and sage whose four original works — written across years of intense personal experience, solitude and spiritual searching — constitute one of the most remarkable bodies of wisdom literature produced in the Iberian Peninsula since the great mystical traditions of the medieval era.

He is not a professor. Not an academic. He is something rarer: a man who has lived what he writes. For whom truth is not a career — it is a calling. A man who, like the ancient oracular writers before him, sees what others choose not to see and records it with the directness of one who has nothing to protect and everything to give.
